idea_name: Stage3 auto-pick of best Stage2 groups by FIRST_VALUE custom_ontester
mechanism: Stage3 SQL partitions Stage2 passes by parent job and takes FIRST_VALUE(params) ORDER BY custom_ontester DESC so each symbol/TF job contributes its best normalized-profit group into the final multi-symbol EA; optional clustering vs non-clustering branches are compared on profit, Sharpe, and equity linearity.
data_needed: Optimization DB passes with custom_ontester and params; Stage2 job/task IDs; symbols×timeframes grid
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP, EURUSD, GBPUSD on H1 and M30 (example conveyor); Stage3 single-pass assemble
why_new_for_mis: Treats per-symbol/TF best-group selection under a normalized custom criterion as an automated portfolio-composition sensor rather than a one-off manual library export.
quote: from all the results of the passes obtained within the framework of one work of the second stage, we can select the best one in terms of the indicator of the normalized average annual profit.

mechanism: Create many nearly identical optimization projects that differ only in optimization end date; after each project finishes, use its initialization string for a subsequent forward trade window, repeating across a multi-year span to measure how long optimized params keep target profit/drawdown before decay.
data_needed: CreateProject script with fromDate/toDate; optimization DB projects for overlapping windows; forward tester reports per window
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD, EURUSD, EURGBP; H1, M30, M15; example windows ending monthly after 2023.01.01 on 2018.01.01 start
why_new_for_mis: Frames parameter half-life / strategy longevity as an explicit MIS change sensor via scheduled re-optimization experiments rather than a single static backtest.
quote: the EA being studied will be optimized over a certain period (for example, 2 months), after which, using the best settings, trade in the strategy tester over a period of, say, two weeks.

idea_name: More-frequent smaller hot updates vs full-stage wait
mechanism: Author notes Stage-by-stage conveyor forces waiting until all Stage1 then all Stage2 jobs finish before Stage3; hypothesizes that with hot replacement of final-EA init strings, smaller more frequent updates (e.g. per symbol/TF as they complete) may improve live results versus rare full-project refreshes.
data_needed: Hot-swap capable final EA; conveyor that can emit partial groups; comparative forward equity under frequent vs infrequent swaps
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same multi-FX grid as CreateProject defaults
why_new_for_mis: Poses update cadence of re-optimized parameter sets itself as a testable regime-change control knob for MIS.
quote: If we plan to somehow implement a "hot" replacement of the initialization strings of the final EA... then we can make these updates smaller, but more frequent. This may improve the results, but it is still only a hypothesis that needs to be tested.

idea_name: Strategy-parameter hash for cross-group identity and partial hot-swap
mechanism: Each single strategy instance stores hash(params) in the EA DB strategies table; identical hashes across old vs new groups can keep virtual positions alive while non-matching instances are closed and new ones start fresh—enabling partial rather than full parameter replacement.
data_needed: EA database strategies.hash and params; old and new strategy_groups; virtual position state keyed by strategy hash
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: SimpleVolumes instances on GBPUSD and other FX from prior projects; any symbol/TF in init string
why_new_for_mis: Uses a content hash of strategy configuration as an identity sensor so MIS can detect which sleeves of a multi-strategy book are unchanged across re-optimizations.
quote: The hash field in the strategies table will store the hash value of the parameters of a single instance of a trading strategy. It will be possible to use it later to understand whether a single instance from a certain group is identical to an instance from another group.

mechanism: On each new D1 bar, if groupId=0 and useAutoUpdate, CheckUpdate queries MAX(id_group) FROM strategy_groups WHERE to_date <= current simulated/live date; if larger than loaded s_groupId, Save, delete expert, OnInit to load the newer group and close orphan symbol receivers.
data_needed: EA DB strategy_groups.from_date/to_date filled from optimization task dates; daily bar clock; visual/live Save-Load path
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD, EURUSD, EURGBP; groups optimized on short ~4-month windows with staggered end dates; tester 2023.01–2024.01 with monthly swaps
why_new_for_mis: Turns optimization-window end dates into an explicit time-gated regime switch for which parameter cohort is allowed to trade.
quote: SELECT MAX(id_group) FROM strategy_groups WHERE to_date <= '%s' ... return s_groupId < row.groupId;

mechanism: On new bar of chosen TF, CopyRates last signalSeqLen closed candles; if all bearish (open>close) emit BUY, if all bullish emit SELL (mean-reversion after a run); open only if open count < maxCountOfOrders; SL/TP from points or ATR fraction.
data_needed: OHLC rates for symbol/TF; signalSeqLen; periodATR; stopLevel; takeLevel; maxCountOfOrders
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD H4 example Stage1 optimization 2018–2023; designed for multi-symbol multi-TF conveyor
why_new_for_mis: Encodes consecutive same-direction candle runs as a discrete sequence sensor whose length is an optimizable regime feature.
quote: A signal to open a position will be a situation when, at the start of a new bar (candle), all of the previous several candles are directed in the same direction (up or down). If the candles are directed upwards, then we open a SELL position.

idea_name: Mid-quartile ChannelWidth trimmed daily range for ATR-scaled SL/TP
mechanism: ChannelWidth copies n=periodATR daily bars, builds high-low ranges, sorts them, averages only the inner two quartiles (i in [n/4, 3n/4)), returns 2*s/n/Point as width in points; UpdateLevels sets m_sl=stopLevel*width and m_tp=takeLevel*width when periodATR>0, else raw points.
data_needed: D1 (default) MqlRates for symbol; periodATR; stopLevel/takeLevel as ATR fractions
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any strategy symbol; ATR computed on PERIOD_D1 while entries fire on strategy TF (e.g. H4/H1)
why_new_for_mis: Uses a quartile-trimmed range average instead of classic ATR as the volatility normalizer for stops—more robust to outlier days.
quote: Sum the inner two quarters of the bar sizes ... Return the average size in points ... return 2 * s / n / m_symbolInfo.Point();

idea_name: Max-spread gate canceling candle-run open signals
mechanism: After detecting a unidirectional-candle open signal, compare rates[0].spread to m_maxSpread; if spread exceeds the threshold, log IGNORE and zero the signal so no virtual position opens.
data_needed: Current bar spread from CopyRates; maxSpread input in points
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: SimpleCandles Stage1 on GBPUSD/EURUSD/EURGBP H1/M30 among others
why_new_for_mis: Adds an explicit liquidity/cost sensor that vetoes mean-reversion entries when instantaneous spread is hostile.
quote: If the current spread is greater than the maximum allowed, then ... Cancel the signal

idea_name: Cross-symbol/TF candle-series histogram and average candle-size informer
mechanism: SymbolsInformer EA over a lookback of mainTimeframe×mainLength candles computes per symbol×TF: avg candle size (all/buy/sell) in points, avg unidirectional series length (≥2), and counts of series lengths 2..9; recalculates on new bars to calibrate signalSeqLen ranges and compare instruments.
data_needed: CopyRates for listed symbols/TFs; main timeframe length window; optional multi-symbol comma lists
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any listed FX (e.g. AUDCAD defaults; multi-symbol multi-TF demo tables); main TF often D1 with N candles
why_new_for_mis: Turns empirical run-length and candle-size distributions into a pre-optimization sensing layer for whether the same parameter ranges fit different symbols/TFs.
quote: Collecting this kind of information about the price behavior of different instruments will also help answer the question: "Can the same parameter ranges be used for different instruments?"

idea_name: Conveyor max_duration early-stop and console progress UI
mechanism: Adds tasks.max_duration and stops genetic Stage1/2 optimizations when elapsed exceeds the limit; CConsoleDialog shows project/stage/symbol/TF/remaining time. No new market regime, volatility, or liquidity sensor is built.
data_needed: Optimization DB task timers; CreateProject stage1/2 MaxDuration inputs
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: SimpleCandles GBPUSD/EURUSD/EURGBP H1/M30 example; process tooling only
why_new_for_mis: Full read shows conveyor UX and wall-clock control only; no market sensing idea for MIS.
quote: We did not add new functionality to the trading logic, but focused on solving practical problems we encountered while using the system.
